{{family name hatnote|Moreno|Marín|lang=Catalan}}
'''Sergio "Sergi" Moreno Marín''' (born 25 November 1987)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://int.soccerway.com/players/sergi-moreno/55895/ |title=Soccerway profile |access-date=21 February 2018 |archive-date=30 April 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180430114626/https://int.soccerway.com/players/sergi-moreno/55895/ |url-status=live }}</ref> is an [[Andorra]]n [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Midfielder|midfielder]] for [[Sporting d'Escaldes]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20080910023516/http://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/statisticsandrecords/players/player=216057/index.html FIFA player profile] Retrieved on 11 October 2008</ref>

==International career==
He made his debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 14 April 2004 in a friendly game against [[China national football team|China]], becoming at 16 years and 4 months Andorra’s youngest player ever, a record that still stands.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sergi Moreno, international player |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=26394 |website=Eu-football |access-date=29 December 2024 |archive-date=3 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181003181902/https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=26394 |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 12 October 2021, in a [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification – UEFA Group I|2022 FIFA World Cup qualification]] game against [[San Marino national football team|San Marino]], he scored his first and only international goal with Andorra.<ref>{{cite web |title=Andorra 3-0 San Marino |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/590253/andorra-san-marino |website=ESPN |access-date=29 December 2024 |archive-date=5 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250905144923/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/590253/andorra-san-marino |url-status=live }}</ref>
